title: Twenty minutes from glory
tagline: Argentina have controlled the World Cup Final. France have barely had a shot, and Deschamps has just thrown on Coman and Camavinga.

sides.name: Argentina
sides.dilemma: You lead 2–0 and France look beaten. But Mbappé is still on the pitch. Do you close the game down, or keep hunting a third?

sides.name: France
sides.dilemma: Two down, almost nothing created, and the trophy is slipping away. Something has to change before the clock does it for you.

title: Croatia's last push
tagline: Croatia have out-passed France for an hour and still trail 3–1 after Pogba's strike. Thirty minutes left in Moscow.

sides.name: France
sides.dilemma: 3–1 up, and Croatia keep coming. Mbappé is itching to run into the space behind them. How do you see this out?

sides.name: Croatia
sides.dilemma: You've had the ball, France have had the goals. Do you throw bodies forward and risk the counter, or keep probing?

title: Wembley holds its breath
tagline: Shaw scored in the second minute. Since then England have retreated and Italy have taken over the ball.

sides.name: Italy
sides.dilemma: A goal down and dominating the ball, but England's back five won't crack. How do you unlock them?

sides.name: England
sides.dilemma: 1–0 up in a home final, but Italy are camped in your half. Sit tighter, or push back up the pitch before the pressure breaks you?

title: Level in Berlin
tagline: Palmer has just equalised off the bench. Spain have been the better side, but momentum has swung.

sides.name: Spain
sides.dilemma: You've been the better side and it's 1–1. Yamal and Williams are still out wide. Go for the winner, or settle and avoid extra time chaos?

sides.name: England
sides.dilemma: You're level and the crowd has woken up. Do you stay in the low block that kept you alive, or go after a tired Spain?

title: Three down in Istanbul
tagline: Maldini scored in the first minute and Crespo added two before the break. Liverpool trail 3–0 in the Champions League final with 40 minutes left.

sides.name: AC Milan
sides.dilemma: 3–0 up and cruising. Liverpool have to come at you now. Sit on the lead, or keep hunting the fourth?

sides.name: Liverpool
sides.dilemma: 3–0 down in a European final and Milan have been ruthless. Throw everything forward, or tighten up and keep it respectable?

title: Bayern's final, at home
tagline: Thomas Müller headed Bayern in front on 83 minutes at their own stadium. Chelsea, outplayed for most of the night, have one push left.

sides.name: Bayern Munich
sides.dilemma: 1–0 up at home with minutes to go. Chelsea have barely threatened. Close it out, or go for the second?

sides.name: Chelsea
sides.dilemma: Müller has just put Bayern ahead in their own stadium. Six minutes of a Champions League final left. How do you find an equaliser?

title: Five minutes from history
tagline: Diego Godín's first-half header has Atlético on the brink of their first European Cup. Real Madrid need a goal.

sides.name: Real Madrid
sides.dilemma: Atlético lead 1–0 and five minutes are left in the final. How do you break down Simeone's defence?

sides.name: Atlético Madrid
sides.dilemma: 1–0 up, five minutes from your first European Cup. Real will throw everyone forward. Hold the line, or hit them on the break?

title: A shock in Lusail
tagline: Messi's early penalty looked like the start of a routine World Cup opener. Then Saudi Arabia scored twice in five minutes.

sides.name: Argentina
sides.dilemma: Saudi Arabia scored twice in five minutes after the break and lead 2–1. Thirty minutes to save your opening World Cup game.

sides.name: Saudi Arabia
sides.dilemma: You lead Argentina 2–1 at the World Cup. Thirty minutes to hold on. Sit deep, or keep squeezing them high up the pitch?
